packages.name: Meta and Voice of Customer Onboarding
packages.description: ACTIVATION: after this package installs, its package instruction runs the onboarding sequence at the start of the first eligible conversation for each workspace not already recorded in the onboarding roster; a fresh conversation may be required before the instruction is composed. The Meta and Voice of Customer onboarding package. Automatically installed when the VM intent includes the ai-training-club-26 category (installPolicy: auto); it remains available for explicit package installs outside that category. Stages the onboarding docs and ready-made guard blocks into /agent/brain/meta-and-voc-onboarding/, plus the voc-data-pull, voc-audit, meta-ad-performance-analysis, and onboarding-walkthrough skills into the skills root. Post-install first quotes the Default workspace line from the conversation's Motion context verbatim - the workspace the runtime bound the conversation to, never one recalled from folders, rosters, routines, or memory - and states the name, workspaceId, and slug taken from it, then runs the reachability check, creates one daily VoC sync routine per reachable platform per workspace - each pinned to a human-confirmed platform account, since accounts are org-level and ownership is never inferred (files land under /agent/brain/<workspace>/data-sources/voc/<platform>/) - merges the four guard blocks into /agent/user.md, runs the Meta account-context autofill silently, and records the workspace in the runneth:meta-voc-onboarded roster in /agent/user.md; it ends by asking 'Are you ready to begin your onboarding?' - the walkthrough presentation fires only on a human's yes, via the onboarding-walkthrough skill. The first complete VoC backfill offers the manual Voice of Customer Audit; the audit runs only on a person's yes and saves a compiled page for validation and future customer-side WHY questions. Outside those human-gated runs, nothing self-runs. Meta only, one workspace at a time. Everything the package produces is scoped to that workspace's own folder, /agent/brain/<workspace>/, so a second workspace in the same org onboards additively without touching the first. The staged guard files are workspace-agnostic and merged verbatim - nothing in them is substituted at install time; they resolve the workspace folder per conversation.

packages.name: Hook & Script Mining
packages.description: Turns one competitor ad, creator post, adjacent-brand ad, or organic video/image, plus a note on why it caught someone's eye, into a classified swipe-file entry (hook tactic, headline tactic, visual format, or creative mechanic) built against this account's own real evidence, then rolls confirmed patterns into an input bank for the existing ideation engine. Stages the process docs and the hook-script-mining skill into this workspace, plus a package instruction (instructions/activation.md, surfaced by the package manager in every conversation while this package is installed) that gates on the built library - silent once /agent/brain/<workspace>/hook-script-mining/ exists, and otherwise it asks before touching anything and only runs the initial library build (seeding from an existing saved library where one exists, or a live Motion glossary pull where it doesn't; creative mechanics has no Motion tag, so it starts from a universal-mechanics checklist checked against real evidence and creative breakdowns) on a human yes. Every seed or submission holds for a human yes before it's written as live. One asset at a time after that, no bulk pulls in this version. Uses this account's own real ad history, including spend, to seed and rank the swipe-file library itself, but never uses paid performance data to judge creative effectiveness or make scale decisions, and never lets another account's names or figures appear in this account's library.
